Hero_Desc_Scizor:
A clumsy yet adorable troublemaker who calls herself the greatest villain in Elias.
Every deed she attempts is petty and poorly executed, but she remains entirely unaware of the problem.
She works steadily every day toward becoming a magnificent villain.
Album_Like_Scizor: A hero who can stop her
Album_Hate_Scizor: Seeing a hero powerless and dejected
Album_Hobby_Scizor: Watering flower beds, feeding stray cats, cutting and folding colored paper with pinking shears
Album_Wish_Scizor: To become the greatest villain in Elias
Album_Scizor1: Scizor calls herself the worst villain in Elias. Yet her deeds are far too childish and trivial for such a title. She cuts the noodles in noodle dishes with scissors or snips through internet cables.
Album_Scizor2: Scizor claims that her hobbies are a matter of grave secrecy. I followed her covertly and found her feeding stray cats. The next day, she watered and pruned a flower bed. On the third, she sat in her room cutting and folding colored paper with pinking shears, then held conversations with her folded creations.
Album_Scizor3: Scizor likes cutting lines and cords. When I asked why, she insisted that it followed the same principle as wanting to close a running faucet. I had no idea what she meant, so I decided that she merely follows her instincts.
Album_Scizor4: Scizor watched a hero movie and began shedding great tears. She said it was unbearably sad to watch the villain receive a harsh lesson from the hero. Apparently, she empathizes with the villain.
Album_Scizor5: Scizor cut Erpin's cake with scissors instead of a bread knife, then hid nearby with a grin to watch Erpin become upset. When Erpin paid no attention and swallowed the cake in one bite, Scizor seemed to be the one left in shock.
Album_Scizor6: Scizor came to me with a written challenge and asked me to check its spelling. She does not usually care about spelling, but apparently worried because this was a formal letter. When I asked who would receive it, she answered Sphinx. It seems she simply wanted to meet her friend and have fun.
Album_Scizor7: Scizor always insisted that she should appear as the primary villain in Sphinx's comics. When she finally did, she was happier than ever and apparently sent the artist a letter of support and a set of thread snips.
LoveHero_Scizor: A villain is obviously better than a hero. I knew you would choose me!
LoveHeroCancel_Scizor: I knew this would happen! I knew you would betray me! Just you wait!
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Hate1: I expected her to like it, but she did not. She lectured me at length that not every villain likes meat and that assuming otherwise was prejudice.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Hate2: She ate so much of it in the Foreign Species Prison that merely looking at it now irritates her.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like1: She was excited by food that was satisfying to cut with scissors. After gleefully snipping it into countless pieces, she ate it with satisfaction.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like2: She was deeply satisfied, saying its sweet yet bitter flavor resembled the life of a villain. I thought pure sweetness might be better, but her delighted expression kept me silent.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like3: She says a bowl of rice cake soup after an exciting act of villainy warms her stomach and lifts her spirits.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like4: After one bite, she trembled with emotion and asked me to wrap up the rest. She says she will savor it slowly.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like5: She asked whether I had a nutritional supplement that was easy to carry around. After tasting what I offered, she declared it excellent and left with an armful. I am a little worried about what she plans to do.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like6: She likes the chewy texture and sweet filling, and asks whether there is more.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like7: After one bite, she abruptly began rambling about the life of a villain. She was so noisy that I packed several more for her, and she left in delight.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like8: After committing villainy all night, she asked for something to keep her awake. She liked what I offered, saying one bite immediately sharpened her senses.
Food_ChefNote_Scizor_Like9: She placed several in her mouth at once and diligently rolled them around. When I asked why she ate them that way, she said the mingled flavors were strangely delicious.

LoveCall_Scizor:
Hey, Master! Greetings. It is I, Scizor, the strongest, worst, and most fearsome villain!
Master, how has your day been?
No, never mind. You are doing well.
Today, I am once again considering what spectacular incident I should cause.
If I do not step forward, who will~?

I have been thinking, Master, and you are a fairly impressive person yourself.
How should I put it? Hero Sphinx may be my destined rival, but there is another rival no less worthy: the leader of the heroes' den, the Master! That is what I mean.

Do you understand? I have personally selected you as my rival.
This is an incredible honor. Not just anyone receives it.
Well, anyway~ If you ever need a haircut, call me.
I will cut it into whatever style you want, handsome and heroic. Ehehehe. That is all! Ahaha!
Affinity_Scizor_EP01_001: Do you know which words provoke a villain the most?
Affinity_Scizor_EP01_002: You are nothing but a third-rate villain!
Affinity_Scizor_EP01_003: Ghk, th-that is good provocation! Even a third-rate villain gets angry when you strike at the heart of it!
Affinity_Scizor_EP01_004: You actually wanted to become a hero, did you not?
Affinity_Scizor_EP01_005: Sob, if only that hamburger had become a huge success and earned a permanent place on the menu, perhaps I... I too...!
Affinity_Scizor_EP01_006: You are surprisingly nice, are you not?
Affinity_Scizor_EP01_007: A villain usually hears that only after trying to save something and getting battered to pieces. It comes far too late to be provocative.
Affinity_Scizor_EP02_001: I will cut anything that can be cut!
Affinity_Scizor_EP02_002: Could you dice everything in this bowl for me?
Affinity_Scizor_EP02_003: Dicing grains of rice and vegetables is easy! I will leave out the garnet, though. It would ruin my blades!
Affinity_Scizor_EP02_005: Uh, I think I would have to cut the Master in half to do that. Are you all right with that?
Affinity_Scizor_EP02_007: Do you know how long it took to style these? They need to grow to just the right length for the look to work!
Affinity_Scizor_EP03_001: How much do you know about the hero Sphinx? Think you know more than I do?
Affinity_Scizor_EP03_002: I know Sphinx well. I know that hero's taste in food inside and out.
Affinity_Scizor_EP03_003: Really? What does Sphinx like? Meat, as befits a hero? Or perhaps elite secret grape juice?
Affinity_Scizor_EP03_004: I do not remember insignificant heroes.
Affinity_Scizor_EP03_005: S-Sphinx, insignificant? The latest comic was incredible! You know nothing about heroes, Master!
Affinity_Scizor_EP03_006: I wonder. How much do you know?
Affinity_Scizor_EP03_007: We fell into the water together, and I learned Sphinx uses the buy-one-get-one laundry detergent from a Monatium supermarket! It does not smell very good.
Affinity_Scizor_EP04_001: I wish more heroes knew how to decipher mysterious letters.
Affinity_Scizor_EP04_002: Exactly. If they cannot demonstrate even that much quick thinking, they are not heroes.
Affinity_Scizor_EP04_003: Right! I am asking them to prove they are worthy opponents capable of solving my riddles!
Affinity_Scizor_EP04_004: You could simply write the correct date and location and notify them.
Affinity_Scizor_EP04_005: Then I would lose a great deal of preparation time! I need time to plan my operation too!
Affinity_Scizor_EP04_006: Would you like to back the "Priest Giggles and Chuckles Joke Collection"?
Affinity_Scizor_EP04_007: Huh? Back it? What does that mean? And why does the title sound so old-fashioned?
Affinity_Scizor_EP05_001: Once upon a time, I was quite the renowned scissorhands, you know.
Affinity_Scizor_EP05_002: Do not speak like an idle loafer whose best days are behind them.
Affinity_Scizor_EP05_003: Listen to me lament my lot! Would you prefer me to sprawl across the table like a real loafer?
Affinity_Scizor_EP05_004: I am rather renowned as a blade wielder in the Banquet Hall myself.
Affinity_Scizor_EP05_005: You intend to defeat me with that tiny bread knife? Pfft!
Affinity_Scizor_EP05_006: You are still a perfectly good scissorhands.
Affinity_Scizor_EP05_007: S-such warm consolation will cause a ray of hope to sprout in my cold heart... Waaah!
Affinity_Scizor_EP06_001: The Monatium Exotic Species Prison. That was where I nurtured my dream of becoming a villain.
Affinity_Scizor_EP06_003: Well, I skipped every rehabilitation program and focused entirely on reading!
Affinity_Scizor_EP06_004: Oh, a villain burning with vengeance. How impressive.
Affinity_Scizor_EP06_005: Right? Strengthening one's identity in solitude! Impressive, is it not?
Affinity_Scizor_EP06_007: Ugh, that is the one subject I do not want to discuss. Why were they so desperate to make everything rectangular?
Affinity_Scizor_EP07_001: Is being a scissor spirit truly so strange?
Affinity_Scizor_EP07_003: Right? Those stuffy high-ranking spirits complain that too many modern spirits lack tradition, but perhaps this is simply the new trend.
Affinity_Scizor_EP07_005: Huh? Spend a week without scissors and I doubt you would say that again.
Affinity_Scizor_EP07_006: Do you lose to the rock spirit?
Affinity_Scizor_EP07_007: Argh! Do you know how many times I have heard that since becoming the scissor spirit? It is so cruel!
Affinity_Scizor_EP08_001: Why do Elves try to make everything wireless? How boring.
Affinity_Scizor_EP08_002: Indeed. Wired devices possess a certain romance.
Affinity_Scizor_EP08_003: Exactly. No charging, and you get the satisfying snip-snip sensation of cutting.
Affinity_Scizor_EP08_004: It is better than covering all of Monatium in cables.
Affinity_Scizor_EP08_005: Why? A city filled with cables... Is the very thought not exciting?
Affinity_Scizor_EP08_006: You. Because of people like you.
Affinity_Scizor_EP08_007: Then did I contribute to Monatium's development? Ah, do I not receive a certificate or something?
Affinity_Scizor_EP09_001: Ghh...! The plate will not cut! What is it made of?!
Affinity_Scizor_EP09_003: Just wait three years! Score it for three years, and even a plate will split!
Affinity_Scizor_EP09_004: Ha-ha, you noticed! I prepared this plate especially for you!
Affinity_Scizor_EP09_005: Ghh, Master! Not bad! But for a villain like me, this trial is merely experience for the future!
Affinity_Scizor_EP09_006: This is a disposable plate. I can tear it by hand. Here, watch.
Affinity_Scizor_EP09_007: Huh? What? Huh? Was that not a cracked plate? You can tear it?
Affinity_Scizor_EP10_001: What is the most important thing if one wishes to be a proper villain?
Affinity_Scizor_EP10_003: That must be it, right? The ruthlessness to eat both your own precious chocolate-flavored block at breakfast and the share of a fellow inmate who woke up late...
Affinity_Scizor_EP10_005: You are looking me up and down right now. What are you trying to say?
Affinity_Scizor_EP10_006: The speed to escape with ease after holding out until the very end.
Affinity_Scizor_EP10_007: Exactly! Nothing compares to the thrill of taunting them to the bitter end and then making your escape!
Affinity_Scizor_EP11_003: ...Correct. He... Hehe. I am... the greatest... vill... ain... Snore!
Affinity_Scizor_EP11_004: You caused another incident last night...
Affinity_Scizor_EP11_005: Hmm? Mmm... I stayed up all night cutting every internet cable in Monatium... Yawn... I am exhausted.
Affinity_Scizor_EP11_006: Go sleep at your own home!!!
Affinity_Scizor_EP11_007: Gah?! Y-you startled me! Why would you shout and frighten a villain like that? Huh?!
Affinity_Scizor_EP12_001: Master, did you know? Mellow Corporation is actually a tremendous villainous enterprise.
Affinity_Scizor_EP12_002: That is correct. It is an evil company.
Affinity_Scizor_EP12_003: Y-you think so too, Master? As expected... You have a discerning eye. Sob... Anyone who sells limited editions and time-limited products is evil!
Affinity_Scizor_EP12_005: ...What?! Y-you! You worked for Mellow Corporation? You wicked villain! You infamous scoundrel!
Affinity_Scizor_EP12_006: Eisia would enjoy hearing you say that.
Affinity_Scizor_EP12_007: Uh... I told her before, and she beamed from ear to ear. She was so pleased that she even started humming.
Affinity_Scizor_EP13_001: Master! Did you call me? What is it?
Affinity_Scizor_EP13_002: I need an incredible pair of kitchen scissors.
Affinity_Scizor_EP13_003: Oh? Then you called the right person. No spirit knows more about scissors than I do! Ahaha!
Affinity_Scizor_EP13_005: I-it was not me! Wh-what? I mean it! Look at these cables. You can tell at a glance that a hamster gnawed them!
Affinity_Scizor_EP13_006: Please trim the trees in the flower bed.
Affinity_Scizor_EP13_007: ...You called me for such a trivial task? Besides, I already tidied your flower bed yesterday... N-no! Pretend you did not hear that!
Affinity_Scizor_EP14_001: Ugh... I saw a strange stray cat the other day.
Affinity_Scizor_EP14_003: Do you think so? It was white and absolutely enormous... Ugh. All the feed I stole from Monatium disappeared.
Affinity_Scizor_EP14_004: Stray cats are adorable no matter what they do.
Affinity_Scizor_EP14_005: That is true. Hmm, you have a rather discerning eye, Master.
Affinity_Scizor_EP14_006: You are stranger than the cat.
Affinity_Scizor_EP14_007: You call the greatest villain strange?! You should call me frightening! Is that not far too cruel?! Repeat after me: not strange, frightening!
Affinity_Scizor_EP15_001: Uuugh... Today's evil deed was a failure.
Affinity_Scizor_EP15_003: I found a pile of colored paper and mercilessly cut it all up... but someone happened to need small pieces of colored paper and thanked me... I am a failure as a villain...
Affinity_Scizor_EP15_005: Wh-what? N-no, I do not! What outrageous nonsense is that? Have you forgotten Monatium's last blackout?! ...Gasp! Th-this is a secret!
Affinity_Scizor_EP15_006: Failure is a trial on the path to success.
Affinity_Scizor_EP15_007: I-is it? Hmm... Understood. Then I shall commit even more evil deeds until one finally succeeds.
Affinity_Scizor_EP16_003: 'You evil fiend! My nemesis from the promotion match! I will never forgive you!' That was what they said. Ahaha! It made me so happy!
Affinity_Scizor_EP16_005: A Sprite who sweeps the floor with her hair. Her eyes were rather... worn down by something, or perhaps her soul had left her body...
Affinity_Scizor_EP16_006: Did you pick up some litter?
Affinity_Scizor_EP16_007: What? Do I look as though I would do that? Villains do not pick up litter. They scatter it everywhere.
Affinity_Scizor_EP17_001: Master, did you know? Digging through a wall with scissors is surprisingly difficult.
Affinity_Scizor_EP17_002: You state the obvious with remarkable confidence.
Affinity_Scizor_EP17_003: You make it sound as though I am talking nonsense... There is nothing scissors cannot do! Apologize!
Affinity_Scizor_EP17_004: So even scissors struggle with some things.
Affinity_Scizor_EP17_005: Scissors are all-purpose, but certain tasks are admittedly a little difficult. Whew, are there no scissors that can dig through walls properly? Hmm... Must I develop them myself?
Affinity_Scizor_EP17_006: Either way, you did dig through it.
Affinity_Scizor_EP17_007: Yes, yes, of course. Scissors are all-purpose, so they can dig through a mere wall. That was not their intended use, but what matters is that I succeeded.
Affinity_Scizor_EP18_001: Wahah! Did you read the new Sphinx comic?!
Affinity_Scizor_EP18_003: Wh-what?! That is cruel! You know that villain was me, do you not? Master, you are awful!!!
Affinity_Scizor_EP18_004: I did not even know a new volume was released.
Affinity_Scizor_EP18_005: Hah... How can you be so indifferent to the world? Wait, then you do not know about the evil deed I committed last week either? Hmm? Hmm? Answer me!
Affinity_Scizor_EP18_007: A-ahem. Y-you do understand after all. You have a discerning eye. Hehehe...
Affinity_Scizor_EP19_003: Huh? Is that wrong? I am a villain, so of course I am addicted to dopamine... Why else would I commit villainy?
Affinity_Scizor_EP19_004: Perhaps the time has come for a major incident...
Affinity_Scizor_EP19_005: Hehe. You sensed instinctively that an incident was coming. Not bad! As expected of the leader of the heroes who stand against me!
Affinity_Scizor_EP19_007: What? Hah. Was that supposed to be a joke? You were serious? Wow... Truly... the worst...
Affinity_Scizor_EP20_001: Master, do you need any kitchen scissors?
Affinity_Scizor_EP20_002: A knife is more convenient than scissors.
Affinity_Scizor_EP20_003: You do not understand the value of kitchen scissors! Do you know how convenient they are? Huh? You do not? Hand over your scissors! All of them!
Affinity_Scizor_EP20_004: You are not trying to sell scissors that cut hair as secondhand kitchenware, are you?
Affinity_Scizor_EP20_005: Uh, is that not allowed? As long as they cut well, does it matter?
Affinity_Scizor_EP20_006: I desperately need them. Give me everything.
Affinity_Scizor_EP20_007: What do you need? Scissors capable of cutting frozen meat? Or enormous scissors that can cut a fluffy cloud omelet without crushing it? Just say the word!
